targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(*) AS "Nodes Ready"
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (node_name) node_name, status
  FROM kubernetes_node
  WHERE condition = 'Ready'
  ORDER BY node_name, time DESC
) latest
WHERE status = 'True'

SELECT sum(allocatable_millicpu_cores) / 1000.0 AS "Allocatable CPU (cores)"
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (node_name) node_name, allocatable_millicpu_cores
  FROM kubernetes_node
  WHERE allocatable_millicpu_cores IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY node_name, time DESC
) latest

SELECT sum(allocatable_memory_bytes) AS "Allocatable Memory"
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (node_name) node_name, allocatable_memory_bytes
  FROM kubernetes_node
  WHERE allocatable_memory_bytes IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY node_name, time DESC
) latest

SELECT count(*) AS "Deployments Unavailable"
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (deployment_name, namespace) deployment_name, namespace, replicas_unavailable
  FROM kubernetes_deployment
  ORDER BY deployment_name, namespace, time DESC
) latest
WHERE replicas_unavailable > 0

SELECT count(DISTINCT pv_name) AS "PersistentVolumes"
FROM kubernetes_persistentvolume
WHERE $__timeFilter(time)

SELECT count(DISTINCT ingress_name) AS "Ingresses"
FROM kubernetes_ingress
WHERE $__timeFilter(time)

SELECT
  time,
  node_name || ' — ' || condition AS metric,
  status AS value
FROM kubernetes_node
WHERE condition IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(time)
ORDER BY time

SELECT
  node_name AS "Node",
  capacity_millicpu_cores / 1000.0 AS "Capacity CPU (cores)",
  allocatable_millicpu_cores / 1000.0 AS "Allocatable CPU (cores)",
  capacity_memory_bytes AS "Capacity Memory",
  allocatable_memory_bytes AS "Allocatable Memory",
  capacity_pods AS "Capacity Pods",
  allocatable_pods AS "Allocatable Pods"
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (node_name) *
  FROM kubernetes_node
  WHERE capacity_millicpu_cores IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY node_name, time DESC
) latest
ORDER BY node_name

SELECT time, node_name AS metric, cpu_usage_nanocores / 1e9 AS value
FROM kubernetes_node
WHERE cpu_usage_nanocores IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(time) AND node_name IN ($node)
ORDER BY time

SELECT time, node_name AS metric, memory_working_set_bytes AS value
FROM kubernetes_node
WHERE memory_working_set_bytes IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(time) AND node_name IN ($node)
ORDER BY time

SELECT time, node_name AS metric, (fs_used_bytes::float8 / NULLIF(fs_capacity_bytes, 0)) * 100 AS value
FROM kubernetes_node
WHERE fs_used_bytes IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(time) AND node_name IN ($node)
ORDER BY time

WITH deltas AS (
  SELECT
    time,
    node_name,
    (network_rx_bytes - lag(network_rx_bytes) OVER w) / extract(epoch FROM (time - lag(time) OVER w)) AS rx_per_sec,
    (network_tx_bytes - lag(network_tx_bytes) OVER w) / extract(epoch FROM (time - lag(time) OVER w)) AS tx_per_sec
  FROM kubernetes_node
  WHERE network_rx_bytes IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(time) AND node_name IN ($node)
  WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY node_name ORDER BY time)
)
SELECT time, node_name || ' rx' AS metric, rx_per_sec AS value FROM deltas
UNION ALL
SELECT time, node_name || ' tx' AS metric, tx_per_sec AS value FROM deltas
ORDER BY time

SELECT time, node_name || ' / ' || container_name AS metric, cpu_usage_nanocores / 1e9 AS value
FROM kubernetes_system_container
WHERE cpu_usage_nanocores IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(time) AND node_name IN ($node)
ORDER BY time

SELECT time, node_name || ' / ' || container_name AS metric, memory_working_set_bytes AS value
FROM kubernetes_system_container
WHERE memory_working_set_bytes IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(time) AND node_name IN ($node)
ORDER BY time

SELECT time, pod_name AS metric, cpu_usage_nanocores / 1e9 AS value
FROM kubernetes_pod_container
WHERE cpu_usage_nanocores IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(time) AND namespace IN ($namespace)
ORDER BY time

SELECT time, pod_name AS metric, memory_working_set_bytes AS value
FROM kubernetes_pod_container
WHERE memory_working_set_bytes IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(time) AND namespace IN ($namespace)
ORDER BY time

SELECT
  pod_name AS "Pod",
  container_name AS "Container",
  namespace AS "Namespace",
  restarts_total AS "Restarts",
  phase AS "Phase"
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (namespace, pod_name, container_name) *
  FROM kubernetes_pod_container
  WHERE restarts_total IS NOT NULL AND namespace IN ($namespace)
  ORDER BY namespace, pod_name, container_name, time DESC
) latest
ORDER BY "Restarts" DESC

WITH deltas AS (
  SELECT
    time,
    pod_name,
    (rx_bytes - lag(rx_bytes) OVER w) / extract(epoch FROM (time - lag(time) OVER w)) AS rx_per_sec,
    (tx_bytes - lag(tx_bytes) OVER w) / extract(epoch FROM (time - lag(time) OVER w)) AS tx_per_sec
  FROM kubernetes_pod_network
  WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND namespace IN ($namespace)
  WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY pod_name ORDER BY time)
)
SELECT time, pod_name || ' rx' AS metric, rx_per_sec AS value FROM deltas
UNION ALL
SELECT time, pod_name || ' tx' AS metric, tx_per_sec AS value FROM deltas
ORDER BY time

SELECT
  pod_name AS "Pod",
  volume_name AS "Volume",
  namespace AS "Namespace",
  round((used_bytes::numeric / NULLIF(capacity_bytes, 0)) * 100, 1) AS "Used %"
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (namespace, pod_name, volume_name) *
  FROM kubernetes_pod_volume
  WHERE capacity_bytes IS NOT NULL AND namespace IN ($namespace)
  ORDER BY namespace, pod_name, volume_name, time DESC
) latest
ORDER BY "Used %" DESC

SELECT
  deployment_name AS "Name",
  namespace AS "Namespace",
  replicas_available AS "Available",
  replicas_unavailable AS "Unavailable"
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (namespace, deployment_name) *
  FROM kubernetes_deployment
  ORDER BY namespace, deployment_name, time DESC
) latest
ORDER BY "Namespace", "Name"

SELECT
  service_name AS "Name",
  namespace AS "Namespace",
  cluster_ip AS "Cluster IP",
  port AS "Port",
  port_name AS "Port Name"
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (namespace, service_name, port_name) *
  FROM kubernetes_service
  ORDER BY namespace, service_name, port_name, time DESC
) latest
ORDER BY "Namespace", "Name"

SELECT
  ingress_name AS "Name",
  namespace AS "Namespace",
  host AS "Host",
  backend_service_name AS "Backend Service",
  tls AS "TLS"
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (namespace, ingress_name, host) *
  FROM kubernetes_ingress
  ORDER BY namespace, ingress_name, host, time DESC
) latest
ORDER BY "Namespace", "Name"

SELECT
  pv_name AS "Name",
  phase AS "Phase",
  storageclass AS "Storage Class"
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (pv_name) *
  FROM kubernetes_persistentvolume
  ORDER BY pv_name, time DESC
) latest
ORDER BY "Name"
